summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: @ornikar/babel-preset-react@6.1.4 declares a `preinstall: node setup.mjs` lifecycle hook. setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex-named identifiers, string-dispatch tables), detects platform/arch/musl, downloads a Bun release archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp path, chmods it 0755, and invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle using shuffled string arrays and a rotator function — opaque to Node-based inspection and only executable by the freshly-downloaded Bun runtime. The advertised purpose is a Babel preset for React, and index.js is a 12-line re-export of @babel/preset-react; neither the downloaded runtime nor the 727KB opaque payload has any role in a Babel preset. The alternate-runtime pattern (fetching a second language runtime specifically to run a bundled opaque payload at install time) is used to evade Node-scoped supply-chain scanners. Package/content mismatch is consistent with a scope hijack or compromised-maintainer publish under the @ornikar org.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
